The activating feature—typically **yellow, vibrant orange, gold, or white** with sharp black details—stands out against a background of **forest green, dark grey, black, or matte beige**. The feature typically occupies **15–50% of the image** and is positioned centrally or slightly off-center. The neuron remains invariant to the semantic identity of the object (activating for owl eyes, ladybugs, wheels, and lenses alike) and local textures, provided the **round geometry and high figure-ground contrast** are maintained.
